cards.title: Measured at every level
items: Reuse: a spy test sees the existing helper called
Visibility: helper defined, used, or absent in context
Cost: tokens in/out, cacheable input, latency, tool calls
Dead code: share of context, and whether the patch used it

cards.title: Deprioritized
items: Symbol graph (was L7): definitions of referenced symbols + 1-hop callers
Little gain over L2 on reuse tasks; revisit with more cross-file tasks
